_meta.description: P10.T2 eval set: user queries labeled with the memory entries a retriever should surface. expected_output lists the relevant entries as {id, text} pairs (entry ids are stable slugs shared across the eval-set family); a query has at least one relevant entry. Queries deliberately paraphrase, abbreviate, or re-word the stored text rather than copying it.

examples.input: what should I put in my coffee these days?

expected_output.text: User prefers oat milk in coffee

examples.context: paraphrased preference lookup; no keyword overlap with 'oat'

expected_output.text: Priya's birthday is March 14

examples.context: family fact; query uses the relation word, entry uses the name
